title: Modeled Finding
description: Legacy behavior-model contract for a proposed finding. It is non-authoritative and is not emitted by the protocol-v1 fixture path.

target_revision.description: Exact revision (git sha / contract address + chain) the finding is against.

hypothesis_id.description: The FABIUS hypothesis this finding confirms.

triggering_input.description: The input / transaction / call sequence that triggers the vulnerability.

poc_artifact_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the reproducing PoC MARCELLUS built.

verdict.description: A Finding exists only for a confirmed verdict. Everything else stays a Candidate or a NullResult.

payout_class.description: Estimated bounty tier, for CAMILLUS ranking.

in_scope.description: AQUILA's confirmation that the finding falls inside the TargetContract scope.
